create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData graph object from an ASE Atoms object with neighbor cutoff and max neighbors
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert an AtomicData object back to a list of ASE Atoms objects for visualization or analysis
create_atomicdata_from_dict: create an AtomicData object from a Python dictionary containing required keys like pos, atomic_numbers, cell, and edge_index
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into one batched AtomicData object for model inference
extract_example_from_batch: extract a single AtomicData example from a batched AtomicData object by index for inspection or processing
